answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the ivory of a task receipt, and the haven is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit.
